haiku.problem: "Follow this world" is not quite what the verse says. Romans 12:2 says "conformed to this world," which means being shaped by it, not just following it. The question should keep the verse's meaning.
A minor point is asked while the main image of the passage, the one body with many members (card 2-6), is left out. Under the 3 to 4 question limit, that image is more central than the gifts claim.
